fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D150B0 (per-frame update of esv::timeline::ArenaScriptSystem) creates one component on a new entity per 0x28-byte esv::timeline::ArenaScriptEvent (queues at system +0x10 and +0x20, filled by LEGACY_AnubisRequestScriptEvent / LEGACY_OsirisRequestScriptEvent) through bg3.exe+0x2D15540 (default null handle) and copies the first qword; bg3.exe+0x2D15000 replaces it with the null handle when the entity is not alive. The Osiris call (EoCServer.dll+0x12A9360) fills it from its first GUIDSTRING argument.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Second qword of the ArenaScriptEvent, treated the same way; the Osiris call fills it from its second GUIDSTRING argument.

fields.name: Event
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D150B0 copy-constructs the STDString at +0x10 of the event (small-string test on +0x24); the Osiris call fills it from its third (STRING) argument - by the component's name the script event id.

open_questions: Which roles the two entities have (the Osiris function name behind EoCServer.dll+0x12A9360 was not found); the client counterpart eoc::notification::CinematicArenaScriptEventComponent carries two Guids and the string in the same order.
Registered as a regular component (ComponentTypeIdContext) although named OneFrame.
second_pass: Re-read bg3.exe+0x2D150B0: two 8-byte handles and an STDString copied from esv::timeline::ArenaScriptEvent (stride 0x28), which the Toolkit's Osiris call fills from (GUIDSTRING, GUIDSTRING, STRING) - offsets and widths settled on Windows, names of the two entities open. STDString is a builtin of generate.py now (24 bytes), so the earlier external_types override was removed.
